name: The Cage

features.name: Roundhouse Kick
features.description: A near-miss feature for matching symbols.

review:
Fight night on a 3-4-3-4-3-4-3 grid with 5,184 ways and cascading wins. Wild Knockout xBombs explode in a cross around themselves, clearing space for new symbols.

A Roundhouse Kick triggers when three to six of the same symbol line up without making a win – so even near-misses can turn into something. High volatility, 25,000x max and a high 32% hit rate, so it doesn't feel dead for long.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
